insert into CMONEYMARKETFINCOME (OBJECT_ID, S_INFO_WINDCODE, F_INFO_BGNDATE, F_INFO_ENDDATE, F_INFO_UNITYIELD, F_INFO_YEARLYROE, ANN_DATE, OPDATE, OPMODE ) values
(#{item.objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sInfoWindcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.fInfoBgndate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.fInfoEnddate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.fInfoUnityield,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.fInfoYearlyroe,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.annDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.opdate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{item.opmode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select A.OBJECT_ID, A.S_INFO_WINDCODE, date_format(STR_TO_DATE(A.F_INFO_BGNDATE,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') F_INFO_BGNDATE, date_format(STR_TO_DATE(A.F_INFO_ENDDATE,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') F_INFO_ENDDATE, F_INFO_UNITYIELD, F_INFO_YEARLYROE, ANN_DATE, OPDATE, OPMODE from CMONEYMARKETFINCOME A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT B WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE='F06' AND A.S_INFO_WINDCODE = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND B.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' ) AND A.F_INFO_UNITYIELD IS NOT NULL AND ANN_DATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
